messages.Obiectul și imaginea sunt reprezentate p: The object and image are shown in the diagram. The distance and height controls provide the same actions as dragging with a mouse, finger or stylus. In the scene, pinch two fingers to zoom.
messages.Obiectul se află dincolo de 2F. Razele s: The object is beyond 2F. The rays meet on the other side of the lens.
messages.Predicție: cum crezi că va arăta imagine: Prediction: what will the image look like when the object reaches the focus?
messages.Compară două tipuri de lentile și trei t: Compare two lens types and three mirror types. Start with a converging lens.
messages.Trage săgeata sau folosește controalele: Drag the arrow or use the distance and height controls. Arrow keys work when the object is selected; Shift gives larger steps.
messages.Razele colorate arată lumina; liniile în: Coloured rays represent light; dashed lines are geometric extensions. A virtual image cannot be projected onto a screen.
messages.Alege unul dintre experimentele de sub s: Choose an experiment, read the explanation, compare the magnification and check the lens equation.
messages.apasă butonul din antet pentru scena ext: use the header button to expand the scene. Open “Controls” and choose a setting; “More” includes results, tools and full screen. “Size / language” provides 100–300% text and button sizes using A−/A+ or the percentage selector. Your preference is saved, and smaller screens adapt to fit. “Exit board mode” restores the standard layout without resetting the experiment.
messages.Trage obiectul, ecranul sau marcatoarele: Drag the object, screen or markers with one finger or a stylus. Pinch fingers together to zoom out and spread them to zoom in. Sliders, selectors and buttons work by touch. “Touch mode” enlarges controls automatically on detected touch devices; it can also be enabled manually. Explanation windows support finger scrolling.
messages.Lentile subțiri simetrice și oglinzi ide: Symmetric thin lenses and ideal mirrors in the paraxial approximation. The Ox axis points right: x₁ < 0 for a real object on the left, and x₂ is the signed image coordinate. For lenses: 1/f = 1/x₂ − 1/x₁ and β = x₂/x₁. For mirrors on the same global axis: 1/f = 1/x₁ + 1/x₂ and β = −x₂/x₁; a concave mirror has f < 0 and a convex mirror f > 0. For symmetric lenses, |f| = R / [2(n − 1)]; for spherical mirrors, |f| = R/2. Plane-mirror reflection is exact. When |x₁| = |f| for a converging element, emergent rays are parallel and the image is at infinity.
messages.Diametrul limitează razele care ajung pe: The aperture limits rays reaching the element without changing the Gaussian image position. The main laboratory does not model spherical or chromatic aberration, diffraction or radiometric intensity. The light source and screen spot are geometric representations; separate aberration demonstrations are available.
messages.Uneori, simplitatea surprinde: într-o og: In a plane mirror, the image remains upright and equal in size to the object.
messages.Predicție: poți obține o imagine reală s: Prediction: can moving this real object alone produce a real image?
messages.Razele ies paralele. Nu se formează o im: The rays emerge parallel. No image forms at a finite distance; move the object slightly to either side of the focus.
messages.Imaginea apare în spatele oglinzii, exac: The image appears behind the mirror, at exactly the same distance as the object is in front of it.
messages.Pentru {element}, imaginea rămâne virtua: For {element}, the image remains virtual, upright and smaller than the object at any distance.
messages.Obiectul este între focar și sistemul op: The object is between the focus and the element. The rays diverge, and their extensions intersect at the image position.
messages.Obiectul se află la 2F. Imaginea se form: The object is at 2F. The image also forms at 2F, at the same height but inverted.
messages.Obiectul se află dincolo de 2F. Imaginea: The object is beyond 2F. The image forms between F and 2F, where the rays meet.
messages.Obiectul se află între F și 2F. Imaginea: The object is between F and 2F. The image is beyond 2F: real, inverted and larger than the object.
messages.Stânga: x < 0 · dreapta: x > 0 · x₁ < 0: Left: x < 0 · right: x > 0 · x₁ < 0 for the real object
messages.Aceeași axă spre dreapta · oglindă conca: Same rightward global axis · concave mirror: f < 0 · convex mirror: f > 0
messages.R → ∞ · nu există un centru de curbură s: R → ∞ · no finite centre of curvature or focus exists.
messages.Lentilă simetrică: |f| = R / [2(n − 1)]: Symmetric lens: |f| = R / [2(n − 1)] · n = {index}. Centres C₁ and C₂ belong to the two surfaces; R₁ and R₂ have opposite signs.
messages.Focarul F este la jumătatea segmentului: The focus F is halfway along OC. The centre C coincides with 2F in the paraxial construction.
messages.Contururile și cercurile au geometrie ci: The outlines and circles have exact circular geometry, but the displayed thickness is not a simulated lens thickness. This is not exact tracing through a thick lens.
messages.. Contururile și cercurile au geometrie: . The outlines and circles have exact circular geometry, but the displayed thickness is not a simulated lens thickness. This is not exact tracing through a thick lens.
messages.La o oglindă sferică, razele depărtate d: For a spherical mirror, rays far from the axis do not meet at the paraxial focus. The relation |f| = R/2 applies in the paraxial approximation. The demonstration below uses
messages.Verde: raze apropiate de axă. Portocaliu: Green: rays near the axis. Orange: marginal rays. The dotted line Fₚ marks the paraxial focus. A smaller aperture reduces aberration; a full beam would form a spot rather than a single point.
messages.Indicele de refracție depinde de lungime: The refractive index depends on wavelength. In this normal-dispersion example, violet light bends more than red light, so different colours do not share one lens focus. Ideal mirrors do not have this refractive chromatic aberration.
messages.Același fascicul incident, trei focare:: One incident beam, three foci: violet bends more and focuses closer to the lens. Focal separation is visually exaggerated eightfold. The diagram is schematic, not to scale; displayed f values remain calculated values. Colours represent different wavelengths. Paraxial thin-lens construction.
messages.Exemplu didactic cu R = 80 cm și indici: Teaching example with R = 80 cm and illustrative indices, not measurements for a specific glass. The main laboratory uses one index n and does not calculate spectral dispersion.
messages.Coma, astigmatismul, curbura câmpului, d: Coma, astigmatism, field curvature, distortion, diffraction and radiometric intensities are not simulated. Circles C₁/C₂ describe the surfaces; for a lens they must not be confused with the 2F points. For a spherical mirror, C = 2F in the paraxial model.
